exposure: supportive training on ENC of traditional birth attendants and facility staff
tablet-enhanced educational home visits by Community health workers (CHW)
outcome: essential newborn care (ENC) practices in home births
cohort: Women aged 15-49 years with a live birth from 79 rural communities of three districts in Loreto, Peru.
finding: Essential newborn care (ENC) practices in home births improved consistently and changes were sustained over time, despite the onset of the Covid-19 pandemic.
